name: Inubousaki Ichirou
source:
Protagonist of the story. Has a hobby of travelling alone using his favourite car, however had an accident along the way to a certain town.

Fortunately his life was saved by a certain girl but unforeseen events await him.

Has medium build. Bright and positive personality.

Has dated girls but have never lasted long with them.
